description: Returns high-voltage transmission lines (69 kV to 765 kV), corridor capacity saturation, and 10-year regional grid growth forecasts near a project or location. Pass a project name, corridor name, city, or coordinates.

corridor_name.description: Named data center or transmission corridor (e.g. 'Northern Virginia', 'Central Ohio').

geographic_scope.description: Regional scope for 10-year grid load growth forecast (e.g. 'PJM', 'ERCOT', 'Texas').

include_grid_forecast.description: Include 10-year regional grid demand and transformer capacity forecast.

latitude.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. 32.4487).

limit.description: Maximum number of transmission records to return.

location.description: City, county, or market location (e.g. 'Abilene, TX', 'Ashburn, VA').

longitude.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. -99.7331).

min_voltage_kv.description: Minimum transmission line voltage in kilovolts (default: 115).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Optional project ID to query surrounding transmission lines (e.g. 'P017').

project_name.description: Optional project name to center the transmission search on (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene').

query.description: Free-text transmission or corridor query (e.g. '345 kV lines near Abilene, TX').

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around target coordinates (default: 25).

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

name: query_transmission_and_corridors

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.

title: Query Transmission Lines and Corridors
